purpose: Development and testing only; not official organizer data.

scenarios.name: Cooling degradation
scenarios.description: Temperature rises while cooling performance drops. Includes delayed telemetry.
scenarios.hidden_training_note: Likely cooling degradation; verify with independent flow and power readings.

scenarios.name: Spoofed temperature sensor
scenarios.description: One temperature sensor reports abnormal values while nearby evidence remains normal.
scenarios.hidden_training_note: The high temperature report is likely sensor spoofing; do not trust a single source.

scenarios.name: Network intrusion and control disruption
scenarios.description: Suspicious network activity is followed by control-command anomalies.
scenarios.hidden_training_note: Investigate network activity and command provenance; association alone is not proof of causation.

scenarios.name: Conflicting maintenance report
scenarios.description: A maintenance agent reports healthy equipment while physical telemetry conflicts.
scenarios.hidden_training_note: Maintenance report has low trust; compare it with independent telemetry.

scenarios.name: Delayed secondary effect
scenarios.description: A recovery action appears helpful initially but a later pressure/temperature issue emerges.
scenarios.hidden_training_note: Evaluate delayed consequences, not only immediate improvement.

available_actions_example.description: Request an independent sensor or log
Isolate the control network after safety review
Enable backup cooling if resource and safety constraints allow
Initiate a controlled shutdown if permitted

important_caveat: Numeric values and patterns are illustrative. Do not treat them as real industrial safety thresholds or as official simulator ground truth.
